source_page_excerpt: TRANSFORM YOUR COMPANY THROUGH INNOVATION  FOLLOW US ON LINKEDIN  BECOME A CLIENT  This playbook will teach you the tenets of Jobs-to-be-Done and how to apply them in your own organization, whatever your position — just like Arm & Hammer did to grow year-over-year revenue by more than 30%. Or like Microsoft did to turn around a flailing business and double revenue.  And how Bosch entered a new market with a top-selling and top-rated circular saw.  Or how Cox Automotive increased its product install base by 20X.  You get the picture. A R E Y O U R E A D Y T O S E E R E S U LT S L I K E T H E S E F O R Y O U R O W N B U S I N E S S ? THEN IT’S TIME TO DIVE INTO JOBS-TO-BE-DONE CHAPTER 01 CHAPTER 02 CHAPTER 03 CHAPTER 04 1 9 18 31 What is Jobs-to-be-Done?
